children: The annual inflation rate in Cape Verde rose to 0.8% in August 2026 from 0.6% in the prior month.

The main upward pressure came from prices of furnishings & household equipment (4.9% vs 5.9%) in July) and   transportation (4.5% vs 2.5%), while alcoholic beverages and tobacco (4.1% vs 3.6%) and hotels, cafes and restaurants (2.8% vs 2.6%) also contributed.
By contrast, prices decreased for housing & utilities (-1.8% vs 0.1%); communications (-0.4% vs -0.3%) and food & non-alcoholic beverages (-0.4% vs -0.1%).
On a monthly basis, the CPI fell by 0.1% in August, after a 0.2% increase in the preceding month.

title: Cape Verde Inflation Rate Inches Higher to 0.8%
